issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement's task text instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String), while the UML in the problem statement and the solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). The template only contains a TODO (no signature) but the solution defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). This mismatch between the textual task and the UML/solution is likely to confuse students: if they implement addGuestStudents(String) (following the text) but tests expect addGuestStudents(int) the submission will not compile or will fail automated checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md (task text) to request addGuestStudents(int) instead of addGuestStudents(String) so it matches the UML and the reference solution. Additionally, ensure any example usages and the template TODO/comments mention the int parameter (e.g., 'addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)') to remove ambiguity for students.

issues.description: The task describes a method to add guest students but uses different parameter types across artifacts: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) names the method as addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram in the same problem statement and the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declare addGuestStudents(int). The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) contains a TODO for this method but no signature, so students must map the textual description to the expected implementation. This inconsistency (String vs int) can confuse students about the required method signature and whether they must parse a String or accept an int directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent. Prefer updating problem_statement.md so the task reads addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the solution implementation. If textual wording is intended to accept textual input, update the UML, template, and solution to accept a String and document required parsing/validation. Also ensure any tests refer to the chosen signature.
